clue.text: Woman hugged by little one — such an angel!

indicators.note: being hugged by something means being held inside it, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a cub is a young animal, a little one
her is a pronoun standing for a woman

explanation.surface: Someone coos over a woman cuddling a small child, calling the child an angel.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherub is a winged child-like figure from heaven, so a sweet child can be called an angel of this kind.

clue.text: Person who calls is sounding stronger and healthier

indicators.note: sounding says the word for stronger and healthier is heard, not seen

parts.note: haler means more hale, healthier and more robust

explanation.surface: A caller seems to be getting fitter.
explanation.definitionFit: One who hails is one who calls out to someone.

clue.text: Publicity gets one admitted to old judge for pardon

indicators.note: admitted to means let into, so the pieces go inside the word for the old judge

parts.note: a reeve was a local magistrate in Anglo-Saxon England
PR is public relations, publicity
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A publicity campaign gets someone in to see an old judge, seeking a pardon.
explanation.walkthrough: A reeve was a medieval English official who acted as local magistrate.
explanation.definitionFit: A stay of punishment is a pardon or cancellation of a sentence.

clue.text: Tall fellow giving support to runners

definitions.meaning: a lanky person is jokingly called this
runner beans climb up tall poles

explanation.walkthrough: 'Runners' are runner beans, climbing plants trained up poles, not athletes.
explanation.definitionFit: A long thin stick for climbing beans; by extension a lanky person.

clue.text: One whose potential for financial gain is outstanding

definitions.text: One whose potential for financial gain is outstanding

parts.words: One whose potential for financial gain is outstanding
parts.note: outstanding seems to praise someone's prospects, but it means unpaid: the money owed to this person has not yet come in

explanation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding' reads as 'excellent'; in accounts it means 'still owed'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lender is owed money, so the gain coming to that person is a debt still unpaid.

clue.text: Stopped around end of year and folded

indicators.note: the word for stopped goes around the other piece

parts.note: ceased means stopped

indicators.note: end of picks the last letter of year

explanation.surface: Something came to a halt late in the year and went under.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Folded' looks like a business going bust; here it means bent into a fold.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with creases in it has been folded or crumpled.

clue.text: Study one accomplished liable to be repudiated

parts.note: a den is a study, a private room
I is the Roman numeral one
able means skilled, accomplished

explanation.surface: Studying one skilled person who might be disowned.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can be denied is open to being rejected or repudiated.

clue.text: Hot current flowing across river

indicators.note: the word for current flows across the river piece, enclosing it

parts.note: topical means current, of present interest

explanation.surface: A hot stream runs across a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' is not a stream but an adjective meaning up to date.
explanation.definitionFit: Equatorial climates are hot, so this word means very warm.

clue.text: Clubman in long grass is called back

indicators.note: the clubman is placed in the long grass, enclosed by it

parts.note: reeds are tall grasses
a member belongs to a club

explanation.surface: A golfer in the rough is summoned back.
explanation.definitionFit: To recall is to call back to mind.

clue.text: .Lose track of learner in motorway gap

parts.note: MI is the crossword form of the M1, Britain's first long-distance motorway

indicators.note: the learner piece is placed in the word for gap, enclosed by it

parts.note: a space is a gap
L is a learner, from the L-plate on a learner driver's car

explanation.surface: A learner driver loses their way at a break in the motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is a major English motorway, written MI in crosswords. The stray full stop before 'Lose' is an OCR mark, not part of the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To mislay something is to lose track of where it is.

clue.text: Popular figure put in the picture

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
form is shape or figure

explanation.surface: A well-liked personality is shown in a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone in the picture is to tell them the facts, to brief them.

clue.text: Where hides may be tanned

parts.note: hides and tanned suggest leather-making, but the hides are human skins browned by sunlamps

explanation.walkthrough: The tannery picture is false: the hides are people's skins, tanned by artificial sunlight.
explanation.definitionFit: A sunroom with sunbeds is where people go to brown their skin.

clue.text: In which the pros and cons are open to debate

definitions.text: In which the pros and cons are open to debate

parts.words: In which the pros and cons are open to debate
parts.note: pros and cons seems to mean arguments, but read as for and against it is MPs voting unwhipped, open to their own conscience

explanation.walkthrough: In Parliament a vote where party whips give no instruction lets each member vote for or against as they please.
explanation.definitionFit: A parliamentary division without party instruction leaves each member to decide, so the outcome is genuinely open.

clue.text: Person making predictions, favouring a secret formula

parts.note: for means in favour of

indicators.note: a formula is a recipe or mixture, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A tipster backs a secret recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who forecasts the weather or results makes predictions.

clue.text: Always in debt, yet treated with great respect

indicators.note: always is placed in the word for debt, which wraps around it

parts.note: in the red means in debt, so red stands for debt
ever means always

explanation.surface: Someone permanently in debt is nonetheless highly esteemed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone venerated or honoured is treated with great respect.

clue.text: Forcible entry by muscular types in review

indicators.note: entry by the muscular types means they go into the other word
in confirms they go inside the word for review

parts.note: to vet is to examine or review
he-men are muscular men

explanation.surface: Strongmen force their way in during an inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: Something forceful and passionate is vehement.

clue.text: Old star embarrassed by little support

annotationWithheld.why: Old star embarrassed by little support (3,5): RED (embarrassed) + DWARF (little) leaves 'support' with no job; no sound parse found
annotationWithheld.clue: Old star embarrassed by little support

clue.text: Outstanding run by woman

indicators.note: the run piece stands beside the woman's name, placed after it

parts.note: Stella is a woman's name
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A woman makes an excellent run in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A star performance is excellent, so starry or star-like means outstanding.

clue.text: Reject blue act, for a start

indicators.note: for a start says the act piece comes first, before the blue piece

parts.note: a turn is a stage act
down means sad, blue

explanation.surface: Someone rejects a risque act at the outset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blue' suggests a smutty act; it means sad.
explanation.definitionFit: To refuse an offer is to decline it, a common phrasal verb.

clue.text: Weak point of law that's exploited by defence

definitions.text: Weak point of law that's exploited by defence

parts.words: Weak point of law that's exploited by defence
parts.note: a defence lawyer exploits a gap in legislation; in a castle wall a narrow slit is used by defenders

explanation.definitionFit: A gap in the rules that lets someone evade them, and an arrow slit in a fortification.

clue.text: Contents of tenant's agreement covered by afterthought

indicators.note: covered by means wrapped by the other piece

parts.note: PS, postscript, is an afterthought in a letter
a lease is a tenant's agreement

explanation.surface: The terms of a rental contract are hidden in a footnote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contents' looks like a noun (what is inside); it is a verb, 'satisfies'.
explanation.definitionFit: To satisfy or gratify someone is to make them content.

clue.text: Old port run by US city directorate

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
R is the cricket abbreviation for run
a board of directors is a directorate

explanation.surface: An old harbour is managed by the governing body of an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like a harbour, but it is the left side of a ship, once called by this older name.
explanation.definitionFit: The left-hand side of a ship was formerly given this name before 'port' replaced it.

clue.text: Delight about article being used in show

indicators.note: about means going round, so the word for delight goes round the article

parts.note: to revel is to delight
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Joy about an object used in a performance.
explanation.definitionFit: To disclose something is to show it.

clue.text: Account with date once altered

indicators.note: altered says the letters of the words before it are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A story whose date was once changed.
explanation.definitionFit: A short story about a real event is an account of it.

clue.text: Protection for Wellington at the front, perhaps

definitions.text: Protection for Wellington at the front, perhaps

parts.words: Protection for Wellington at the front, perhaps
parts.note: Wellington and the front suggest the Duke at war, but a wellington is a rubber boot, and its front end needs a reinforced tip

explanation.walkthrough: A wellington is a British rubber boot; the military picture of the Duke at the front is the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: A reinforced cap over the front of a boot protects the wearer's toes.

clue.text: Break in journey to leave off deliveries

parts.note: to stop is to leave off
in cricket an over is a set of six deliveries by one bowler

explanation.surface: A traveller takes a break and stops getting deliveries.
explanation.definitionFit: A short halt on the way somewhere is an interruption in travel.

clue.text: Confirms charges, provided I get accepted

indicators.note: being accepted means being taken in, so the pieces go inside the word for charges

parts.note: rates are charges
if means provided

explanation.surface: Someone approves the fees, as long as they are allowed in.
explanation.definitionFit: To approve something formally is to confirm it.

clue.text: It's pushed through to create the design of the sewer

definitions.text: It's pushed through to create the design of the sewer

parts.words: It's pushed through to create the design of the sewer
parts.note: sewer suggests a drain, but it is one who sews, whose embroidery design is made by pushing a slim pointed tool through cloth

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sewer' reads as a drain; it is a person who sews.
explanation.definitionFit: The slim pointed sewing tool carries thread through fabric to make stitches.
